issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §4.2 and §6.8 operator precedence
issues.evidence: Spec precedence lists `is, as` above `|`. Probe `.temp/qa/fp02_skeptic/probe_before.log`: native `fhirpath('{}', '1 | 2 is Integer')` returned [] with `fhirpath_is_valid=false`; forced Python fallback returned ["1", "true"] with `fhirpath_is_valid=true`. Native `1 | 'a' as String` showed the same invalid/empty behavior while fallback returned ["1", "a"].
issues.root_cause: Native recursive-descent parser parsed a full membership/equality/union expression before applying `is`/`as`, making type operators bind lower than union instead of above union.
issues.resolution: Reordered native parser precedence so membership -> inequality -> equality -> union -> type -> additive, matching FHIRPath §6.8 for `is/as` above `|`; added native/fallback parity and native SQL regression coverage.
issues.verified_in: `.temp/qa/fp02_skeptic/probe_after.log` mismatch_count=0; `python3 -m pytest fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/tests/integration/test_operator_parity.py fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/tests/integration/test_type_parity.py fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/tests/integration/test_existence_parity.py fhir4ds/fhirpath/duckdb/tests/integration/test_equality_parity.py -q` passed 31/31; `./extensions/fhirpath/build/release/test/unittest "*fhirpath*"` passed 334 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath Normative Release §4.5 singleton evaluation of collections
issues.evidence: Probe `.temp/qa/fp02_skeptic/probe_before.log`: native `names.trim()` over two string items returned ["Ann"], while forced Python fallback returned [] through public row-level resilience. `trim()` is an extension surface, but it still expects a singleton string input.
issues.root_cause: Native `fn_trim` handled empty input and type shape but did not enforce singleton input before using `input[0]`, unlike the forced Python fallback string singleton helper.
issues.resolution: Added a native multi-item guard that raises `FHIRPathSpecError`, allowing public DuckDB UDFs to return empty/NULL through existing row resilience; added native/fallback parity and native SQL regression coverage.
issues.verified_in: `.temp/qa/fp02_skeptic/probe_after.log` mismatch_count=0; focused parity pytest passed 31/31; native SQL unittest passed 334 assertions; full conformance 2822/2822.
